mapper.sql: d.id, d.post_id, case when d.user_id is null then d.nickname else coalesce(u.display_name, d.nickname) end as nickname, d.content, d.status, d.created_at, d.parent_id, d.reply_to_nickname, (select count(*) from danmaku_like l where l.danmaku_id = d.id) as like_count, (select count(*) > 0 from danmaku_like l where l.danmaku_id = d.id and l.ip_hash = #{ipHash}) as liked
mapper.select: select id, post_id, nickname, content, status, created_at, parent_id, reply_to_nickname, like_count, liked from ( select from danmaku d left join app_user u on u.id = d.user_id where d.post_id = #{postId} and d.status = 'VISIBLE' order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc limit 80 ) recent order by created_at asc, id asc

select id, post_id, nickname, content, status, created_at, parent_id, reply_to_nickname, like_count, liked from ( select from danmaku d left join app_user u on u.id = d.user_id where d.post_id is null and d.status = 'VISIBLE' order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc limit 80 ) recent order by created_at asc, id asc
select from danmaku d left join app_user u on u.id = d.user_id order by d.created_at desc, d.id desc limit 80
select from danmaku d left join app_user u on u.id = d.user_id where d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into danmaku (post_id, parent_id, reply_to_nickname, user_id, nickname, content, status, ip_hash) values (#{postId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{parentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{replyToNickname}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{nickname}, #{content}, #{status}, #{ipHash})
mapper.update: update danmaku set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from danmaku_like where danmaku_id = #{danmakuId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
mapper.insert: insert into danmaku_like (danmaku_id, ip_hash, user_id) values (#{danmakuId}, #{ipHash}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.delete: delete from danmaku_like where danmaku_id = #{danmakuId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
